title: Full Stack Developer
description:

Familiarity with .NET Core Web API fundamentals, JSON serialization, statusAPI codes, and API versioning to collaborate effectively with backend teams. Collaborate with backend engineers on API design, versioning, pagination, and error schemas; document API usage and UI contracts. Solid understanding of responsive design, accessibility standards, and cross\-browser compatibility. Experience with performance profiling, Core Web Vitals, and build\-time optimizations. title: Custom Software Engineering Lead
description:
**Project Role :** Custom Software Engineering Lead  

**Project Role Description :** Own the technical direction and architecture of custom software solutions, leading teams through design and delivery. Set development standards and ensure code quality, scalability, and performance aligned to business objectives.
  

**Must have skills :** AWS Architecture  

**Good to have skills :** Node.js, Go Programming Language  

Minimum **5** year(s) of experience is required  

**Educational Qualification :** 15 years full time education  

  

Summary  

  

As a Node.js Backend Developer, you will design, develop, and support scalable backend applications for OTT and digital media platforms. The role focuses on API development, AWS integration, production support, and delivering reliable solutions using Node.js, TypeScript, and cloud\-native technologies.  

  

Roles \& Responsibilities  

Perform independently as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) in Node.js backend development.  

Design, develop, and enhance backend and Backend\-for\-Frontend (BFF) services using Node.js and TypeScript.  

Build RESTful and Graph QL APIs supporting catalog management, metadata, entitlement, playback authorization, and device registration.  

Develop API aggregation and response transformation layers for Web, Mobile, Smart TV, and Set\-Top Box platforms.  

Integrate applications with AWS services including AWS Lambda, Amazon DynamoDB, Amazon S3, Amazon SQS, Amazon SNS, Amazon API Gateway, and Amazon ECS.  

Write maintainable JavaScript and TypeScript code following development standards.  

Develop and maintain automated unit, integration, and regression tests.  

Participate in code reviews, CI/CD processes, and release activities.  

Analyze production incidents, perform root cause analysis, and resolve performance issues.  

Troubleshoot Node.js runtime issues, including memory leaks, event loop latency, connection pool exhaustion, and timeout\-related issues.  

Collaborate with development, operations, architecture, and business teams.  

Contribute to technical documentation, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement activities.  

Participate in on\-call and production support activities.  

Professional \& Technical Skills  

Must\-Have Skills  

Strong experience in Node.js and TypeScript development.  

Experience building RESTful and Graph QL APIs.  

Hands\-on experience with Express.js, Factify, or Nest JS.  

Experience with AWS services including AWS Lambda, Amazon DynamoDB, Amazon S3, Amazon SQS, Amazon SNS, Amazon API Gateway, and Amazon ECS.  

Strong understanding of asynchronous programming, Promises, Async/Await, Streams, Event Emitter, and error handling.  

Experience with relational and NoSQL databases.  

Experience with automated testing frameworks such as Jest, Mocha, and Super test.  

Experience with Git, CI/CD pipelines, and Docker.  

Experience monitoring applications using Amazon CloudWatch or similar tools.  

Experience supporting production applications and troubleshooting incidents.  

Good\-to\-Have Skills  

Experience in OTT, Streaming, Broadcast, or Digital Media platforms.  

Knowledge of HLS, DASH, DRM technologies including Wide vine, PlayReady, and Fair Play.  

Understanding of Content Delivery Networks (CDN) and Server\-Side Ad Insertion (SSAI).  

Experience with Apollo Graph QL Server and schema design.  

Knowledge of Node.js Streams and backpressure handling.  

Exposure to AWS Media Services including Media Convert, Media Package, Media Tailor, Event Bridge, Kinesis, and Step Functions.  

Experience with Terraform, AWS Cloud Development Kit (AWS CDK), or AWS CloudFormation.  

Basic knowledge of Kubernetes, Amazon EKS, Redis, Amazon Elasti Cache, Grafana, Elastic Stack, Datadog, and Open Telemetry.  

Exposure to ServiceNow, Jira Service Management, and IT Service Management (ITSM) processes.  

Additional Information  

Minimum 5 years of relevant experience in Node.js backend development.  

Experience working in Agile and DevOps environments.  

Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem\-solving skills.  

Experience with cloud\-native application development is preferred.  

Minimum 15 years of full\-time education required.


  

15 years full time education

title: Software Engineering Manager-Insights Application
description:
Join ABC Fitness and become part of a culture that’s as ambitious as it is authentic. Let’s transform the future of fitness—together!


Our Values

**Best Life**


We believe great work begins with great people. That’s why our culture is built on respect, trust, and belonging. We create an inclusive environment where every team member can bring their authentic self to work—because diverse perspectives drive innovation and meaningful impact.

**Growth Mindset**


We are doers, thinkers, and dreamers. At ABC Fitness, your growth is our investment. Through continuous learning, mentorship, and professional development opportunities, we empower you to reach new heights—personally and professionally.

**One Team**


From day one, you’ll be part of a team that collaborates, celebrates, and cares. We move fast, support one another, and have fun along the way. Because when you thrive, we all thrive.


**RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Lead and coach a team across backend, frontend, cloud, DevOps, production support, and release validation responsibilities.
* Provide hands\-on technical leadership for a production web application environment built around .NET / C\#, APIs, React / Redux, current Azure services, and modern CI/CD practices, while leading the team's cloud migration to AWS.
* Help define the next\-generation direction for the Insights application, including modernization, architecture, AWS target\-state design, scalability, reliability, maintainability, and developer productivity with AI\-assisted tooling such as Cursor.
* Own delivery execution across roadmap work, technical debt, operational improvements, incident response, release readiness, and production support.
* Partner closely with Product, Data Engineering, QA, DevOps, Support, and business stakeholders to translate priorities into clear technical plans, backlog decisions, acceptance criteria, and delivery outcomes.
* Improve engineering practices across code quality, review discipline, automated testing, observability, release management, incident learning, service\-level objectives, and responsible use of AI coding tools including Cursor.
* Support transition and long\-term ownership of complex or partner\-built application components into full\-time team accountability.
* Strengthen application reliability across multi\-tenant architecture, customer access models, background processing, messaging, integrations, and data platform dependencies.

**QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Recent hands\-on experience designing, building, reviewing, and operating production web applications; this is not a people\-only management role.
* Strong technical background in .NET / C\#, API development, React or comparable SPA frameworks, and modern web application architecture.
* Experience leading engineering teams through delivery planning, technical decision\-making, production support, and release execution.
* Working knowledge of the current Azure production stack (App Service, Service Bus, Azure SQL, Key Vault, Blob Storage, Entra ID, or comparable services), plus hands\-on AWS experience to lead and execute the platform migration to AWS.
* Hands\-on AWS experience with production application workloads (for example EC2 / ECS / EKS / Lambda, RDS, S3, SQS / SNS, IAM, Secrets Manager, CloudWatch, and AWS\-aligned CI/CD), including cloud migration or platform cutover experience.
* Practical experience with AI\-assisted software development, including Cursor (or a closely comparable AI coding assistant / IDE), and the ability to apply it to design, coding, code review, testing, documentation, and incident analysis while keeping humans accountable for production quality.
* Experience with CI/CD, release engineering, environment management, and migration or improvement of build and deployment workflows.
* Ability to operate in a production environment, including incident management, root\-cause analysis, observability, service health, and reliability improvement.
* Strong collaboration with Product or Product Owner functions, including backlog shaping, acceptance criteria, tradeoff decisions, and roadmap execution.
* Ability to coach engineers at all experience levels, create accountability, and balance hands\-on technical guidance with people leadership.

**IT'S GREAT TO HAVE:**

* Experience with Power BI, embedded analytics, or other BI / reporting platforms.
* Deeper AWS architecture experience (landing zones, networking, identity, cost management, or large\-scale Azure\-to\-AWS application migration).
* Experience establishing team standards for AI\-assisted development with Cursor, including prompt/review practices, security guardrails, and measuring productivity impact.
* Experience with multi\-tenant architecture and hierarchical customer access models.
* Experience modernizing a large, long\-lived frontend application, including framework and build\-toolchain upgrades.
* Familiarity with warehousing, ETL, data engineering partnerships, or data platform adjacency.
* Experience with payments, billing integrations, SSO, identity federation, SOC 2, vertical SaaS, fitness, wellness, or multi\-product platform environments.

**WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE:**

* Clear ownership, stable delivery rhythms, and strong accountability across application development and production support.
* The current application is better understood, better documented, more reliable, and easier for the team to operate and enhance.
* A practical next\-generation application direction is defined, with clear modernization priorities, an Azure\-to\-AWS migration sequence, and team adoption of AI\-assisted engineering (including Cursor).
* Releases are more predictable, incidents are managed with discipline, and quality validation improves across environments.
* Engineers on the team receive strong technical guidance, coaching, prioritization, and support for growth.


**WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU:**

* Purpose led company with a Values focused culture – Best Life, One Team, Growth Mindset
* Time Off – competitive PTO plans with 15 Earned accrued leave, 12 days Sick leave, and 12 days Casual leave per year
* 11 Holidays plus 4 Days of Disconnect – once a quarter, we take a collective breather and enjoy a day off together around the globe. \#oneteam
* Group Mediclaim insurance coverage of INR 500,000 for employee \+ spouse, 2 kids, and parents or parent\-in\-laws, and including EAP counseling
* Life Insurance and Personal Accident Insurance
* Best Life Perk – we are committed to meeting you wherever you are in your fitness journey with a quarterly reimbursement
* Premium Calm App – enjoy tranquility with a Calm App subscription for you and up to 4 dependents over the age of 16
* Support for working women with financial aid towards crèche facility, ensuring a safe and nurturing environment for their little ones while they focus on their careers


At ABC Fitness, we don’t just build technology—we build communities and transform lives. Your work matters here, your growth is supported, and your voice is heard. We welcome diverse talent and encourage you to apply, even if you don’t meet every requirement.

**ABC’S COMMITMENT TO DIVERSITY, EQUALITY, BELONGING AND INCLUSION**: ABC is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion. We strive to create a workplace where every employee, client, and partner feels valued, inspired, and empowered to reach their full potential. For us, inclusion isn’t just the right thing to do—it’s a business imperative. Learn more at **abcfitness.com**.


About ABC Fitness


ABC Fitness is the \#1 software provider for fitness businesses of any size, all around the world. Supporting 30K clubs, 650K coaches, 40M members, and processing more than $12B in payments every year, ABC Fitness provides scalable, data\-driven solutions to simplify club management and engage members and clients.


From personal trainers, boutique studios, and gyms, to international franchise health clubs, ABC Fitness will move your business forward through technology and industry insights. Innovation is at the center of everything we do, across ABC Glofox, ABC Ignite, ABC Trainerize, and ABC Evo. Let's make your fitness vision a seamless reality, together. Learn more at **abcfitness.com**

title: Manager, Insights Application
description:
Join ABC Fitness and become part of a culture that’s as ambitious as it is authentic. Let’s transform the future of fitness—together!


Our Values

**Best Life**


We believe great work begins with great people. That’s why our culture is built on respect, trust, and belonging. We create an inclusive environment where every team member can bring their authentic self to work—because diverse perspectives drive innovation and meaningful impact.

**Growth Mindset**


We are doers, thinkers, and dreamers. At ABC Fitness, your growth is our investment. Through continuous learning, mentorship, and professional development opportunities, we empower you to reach new heights—personally and professionally.

**One Team**


From day one, you’ll be part of a team that collaborates, celebrates, and cares. We move fast, support one another, and have fun along the way. Because when you thrive, we all thrive.


**RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Lead and coach a team across backend, frontend, cloud, DevOps, production support, and release validation responsibilities.
* Provide hands\-on technical leadership for a production web application environment built around .NET / C\#, APIs, React / Redux, current Azure services, and modern CI/CD practices, while leading the team's cloud migration to AWS.
* Help define the next\-generation direction for the Insights application, including modernization, architecture, AWS target\-state design, scalability, reliability, maintainability, and developer productivity with AI\-assisted tooling such as Cursor.
* Own delivery execution across roadmap work, technical debt, operational improvements, incident response, release readiness, and production support.
* Partner closely with Product, Data Engineering, QA, DevOps, Support, and business stakeholders to translate priorities into clear technical plans, backlog decisions, acceptance criteria, and delivery outcomes.
* Improve engineering practices across code quality, review discipline, automated testing, observability, release management, incident learning, service\-level objectives, and responsible use of AI coding tools including Cursor.
* Support transition and long\-term ownership of complex or partner\-built application components into full\-time team accountability.
* Strengthen application reliability across multi\-tenant architecture, customer access models, background processing, messaging, integrations, and data platform dependencies.

**QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Recent hands\-on experience designing, building, reviewing, and operating production web applications; this is not a people\-only management role.
* Strong technical background in .NET / C\#, API development, React or comparable SPA frameworks, and modern web application architecture.
* Experience leading engineering teams through delivery planning, technical decision\-making, production support, and release execution.
* Working knowledge of the current Azure production stack (App Service, Service Bus, Azure SQL, Key Vault, Blob Storage, Entra ID, or comparable services), plus hands\-on AWS experience to lead and execute the platform migration to AWS.
* Hands\-on AWS experience with production application workloads (for example EC2 / ECS / EKS / Lambda, RDS, S3, SQS / SNS, IAM, Secrets Manager, CloudWatch, and AWS\-aligned CI/CD), including cloud migration or platform cutover experience.
* Practical experience with AI\-assisted software development, including Cursor (or a closely comparable AI coding assistant / IDE), and the ability to apply it to design, coding, code review, testing, documentation, and incident analysis while keeping humans accountable for production quality.
* Experience with CI/CD, release engineering, environment management, and migration or improvement of build and deployment workflows.
* Ability to operate in a production environment, including incident management, root\-cause analysis, observability, service health, and reliability improvement.
* Strong collaboration with Product or Product Owner functions, including backlog shaping, acceptance criteria, tradeoff decisions, and roadmap execution.
* Ability to coach engineers at all experience levels, create accountability, and balance hands\-on technical guidance with people leadership.

**IT'S GREAT TO HAVE:**

* Experience with Power BI, embedded analytics, or other BI / reporting platforms.
* Deeper AWS architecture experience (landing zones, networking, identity, cost management, or large\-scale Azure\-to\-AWS application migration).
* Experience establishing team standards for AI\-assisted development with Cursor, including prompt/review practices, security guardrails, and measuring productivity impact.
* Experience with multi\-tenant architecture and hierarchical customer access models.
* Experience modernizing a large, long\-lived frontend application, including framework and build\-toolchain upgrades.
* Familiarity with warehousing, ETL, data engineering partnerships, or data platform adjacency.
* Experience with payments, billing integrations, SSO, identity federation, SOC 2, vertical SaaS, fitness, wellness, or multi\-product platform environments.

**WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE:**

* Clear ownership, stable delivery rhythms, and strong accountability across application development and production support.
* The current application is better understood, better documented, more reliable, and easier for the team to operate and enhance.
* A practical next\-generation application direction is defined, with clear modernization priorities, an Azure\-to\-AWS migration sequence, and team adoption of AI\-assisted engineering (including Cursor).
* Releases are more predictable, incidents are managed with discipline, and quality validation improves across environments.
* Engineers on the team receive strong technical guidance, coaching, prioritization, and support for growth.


**WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU:**

* Purpose led company with a Values focused culture – Best Life, One Team, Growth Mindset
* Time Off – competitive PTO plans with 15 Earned accrued leave, 12 days Sick leave, and 12 days Casual leave per year
* 11 Holidays plus 4 Days of Disconnect – once a quarter, we take a collective breather and enjoy a day off together around the globe. \#oneteam
* Group Mediclaim insurance coverage of INR 500,000 for employee \+ spouse, 2 kids, and parents or parent\-in\-laws, and including EAP counseling
* Life Insurance and Personal Accident Insurance
* Best Life Perk – we are committed to meeting you wherever you are in your fitness journey with a quarterly reimbursement
* Premium Calm App – enjoy tranquility with a Calm App subscription for you and up to 4 dependents over the age of 16
* Support for working women with financial aid towards crèche facility, ensuring a safe and nurturing environment for their little ones while they focus on their careers


At ABC Fitness, we don’t just build technology—we build communities and transform lives. Your work matters here, your growth is supported, and your voice is heard. We welcome diverse talent and encourage you to apply, even if you don’t meet every requirement.

**ABC’S COMMITMENT TO DIVERSITY, EQUALITY, BELONGING AND INCLUSION**: ABC is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion. We strive to create a workplace where every employee, client, and partner feels valued, inspired, and empowered to reach their full potential. For us, inclusion isn’t just the right thing to do—it’s a business imperative. Learn more at **abcfitness.com**.

ABC Fitness is the \#1 software provider for fitness businesses of any size, all around the world. Supporting 30K clubs, 650K coaches, 40M members, and processing more than $12B in payments every year, ABC Fitness provides scalable, data\-driven solutions to simplify club management and engage members and clients.


From personal trainers, boutique studios, and gyms, to international franchise health clubs, ABC Fitness will move your business forward through technology and industry insights. Innovation is at the center of everything we do, across ABC Glofox, ABC Ignite, ABC Trainerize, and ABC Evo. Let's make your fitness vision a seamless reality, together. Learn more at **abcfitness.com**

description:

Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start **Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**

  

We are looking for an experienced Full Stack Java Developer to design, develop, and maintain scalable web applications using Java/Spring Boot on the backend and React.js on the frontend. The ideal candidate is comfortable working across the entire stack, from building RESTful APIs and data models to creating responsive, user\-friendly UI components, and can collaborate effectively with cross\-functional teams to deliver high\-quality software. Resource should be AI builder and should be having good knowledge of AI building tools like codex copilot GPT and other Azure AI services to automate and improve the existing process.

 **Primary Responsibilities:**

* Design, develop, and maintain web applications using Java, Spring Boot, and React.js
* Build and consume RESTful APIs / microservices, ensuring performance, security, and scalability
* Develop responsive and reusable UI components using React, Redux/Context API, HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript/TypeScript
* Design and optimize relational/NoSQL database schemas (e.g., MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB) and write efficient queries
* Integrate frontend applications with backend services and third\-party APIs
* Write unit, integration, and end\-to\-end tests (JUnit, Mockito, Jest, React Testing Library) to ensure code quality
* Participate in code reviews, follow coding standards, and maintain clean, well\-documented code
* Troubleshoot, debug, and resolve production issues across the stack
* Collaborate with product managers, UI/UX designers, QA, and DevOps teams throughout the SDLC
* Participate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies (sprint planning, stand\-ups, retrospectives)
* Implement CI/CD pipelines and support containerized deployments (Docker, Kubernetes)
* Ensure application security best practices (authentication, authorization, input validation, OWASP guidelines)
